theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (Γ : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn m) (S : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn k) (T : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)), Function.Surjective Γ → (∀ v, (T v).fst = Γ v) → (∀ v, (T v).snd = S v) → T.normDet = (Γ.domRestrict (LinearMap.ker Γ)ᗮ).normDet * (S ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ).subtype).normDet
